completeness_gate.required: Every originally planned calibration row has known paired gain and every raw coordinate lies within the train-only observed minimum/maximum; no discarded rows

next_prerequisites.required: A separately frozen new development plan, exact current source/model/context/receipt identities, honest retained historical denominators, disjoint registered fit/calibration/evaluation sources; no old evaluation material repurposed as calibration or independent confirmation.

A priori training-domain coverage using actual permitted training observations; refit only through the original admitted-input path. Do not clip live/calibration inputs, expand limits from evaluation, drop planned outliers, change alpha, relabel a source or overwrite a checkpoint.

Before evaluating benefit, both content-specific checkpoints must recompute complete=true over every registered calibration row and retain at least nine distinct admitted sources per registered target cell, with unchanged rank and strict checkpoint parser. Diagnostic-consumed material must retain its exposure status.

Use authentic new fit/adaptation/freeze/cold-load artifacts as required by the original API; the adaptation receipt binds the frozen-study SHA and fit-source set. Never copy an old receipt, pin, export or START under a new run identity.

Only an in-envelope, budget-valid public state with finite fitted score plus the original non-null residual correction can reach the existing score>0 READ decision. Calibration gate success may correctly yield nonpositive_value/STOP; do not force READ. Preserve full-cost unknowns until provider, energy, fit, calibration and tuning costs are actually measured.

budget_example_preserving_current_layout.scope: Planning counts only; no new run dispatched; this baseline is not evidence that 24 training sources cover the required domain or that statistical power is adequate

mechanical_calibration: Original planned/exported counts agree; zero UNKNOWN rows admitted to fitting
All four selected fit/calibration canonical input digests match original checkpoints
Training envelope remains train-only and unaltered; every planned calibration row is inside it
Both checkpoint complete flags are true and all target-cell ranks are >=1
Authentic cold readback binds the exact source/model/context and frozen time budget
acceptance.scientific_benefit: Still requires the original predeclared source-level effect/power/confirmation and full-cost criteria; nine sources and one READ do not satisfy these criteria.
